relevance_note: The paper reports three Tangier disease kindreds with ABCA1 genotypes and clinical details: 'We identified homozygosity or compound heterozygosity for pathogenic mutations in ABCA1 in 6 individuals'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script in the scratch directory only assembled the JSON and checked spans. The paper has no tables; all values come from text and figure legends (pedigree figures are not available as images). Labels: the probands of Family 1 and Family 3 have no own label (only role words), so they are 'unnamed person 1' (Family 1 proband, first mentioned) and 'unnamed person 2' (Family 3 proband); the Family 2 proband is '301' and his parents '201'/'202' from the text; extended relatives 204, 207, 318 use the pedigree numbers given in the text (relation to proband not stated); the three Family 2 siblings have no labels or sex, so 'sibling of 301', 'sibling of 301 2', 'sibling of 301 3'. Three previously published people with individual-level facts were included: the Candini et al. 2010 patient (compound heterozygous for the Family 1 mutation and an unprinted second missense variant, kept with variant_original_string 'not reported'), the Lachaux et al. 1998 four-month-old infant (clinical Tangier disease, no molecular confirmation, no variant rows) and the Service et al. 2014 individual (p.Thr940Met with low cholesterol, zygosity not stated). Not included: 'patients' in Bodzioch 1999/Uehara 2008 with p.Arg937Val/p.Thr940Met (no individual-level detail) and the four Koseki et al. 2009 probands (group-level only). Variant values decode the Markdown escapes (> -> '>', '\_' -> '_'); spans keep the Markdown text exactly. The transcript NM_005502.3 comes from the Methods statement that all mutations were named against it (not applied to previously published patients). The Family 1 parental-testing sentence is interrupted in the Markdown by a misplaced Fig. 2 legend fragment, so it is quoted as two separate spans and not joined. The Family 1 homozygous proband's inheritance is left 'not reported' because both parents carry the variant and the enum has no biallelic option; the statement is in parental_testing_statement. Family 3 father 'also carried' the frameshift without a stated zygosity, so zygosity is 'not reported'. Pathogenicity left 'not reported' except the intronic variant ('pathogenic de novo mutation'); the general '6 individuals' sentence was not used because it does not name a group. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null: the Family 1 electron-microscopy finding is 'as previously described (Meersseman et al. 2010)', which may or may not mean this patient was reported before. Group statements used: 'no family history of premature coronary artery disease in any members of the family' (Family 2, excluded for all nine Family 2 rows; the narrower premature-CAD absence does not exclude the checklist 'coronary artery disease'); 'All three of the proband's siblings had extremely low levels of HDL-C and apoA-I' (observed, marked inferred from group statement); 'the heterozygous parents' (Family 1 glucose findings); 'family member controls with normal fasting blood sugars' (Family 1 parents and sister). Family 1 sister's 'normal plasma lipoprotein levels' recorded as excluded 'abnormal plasma lipoprotein levels' only; checklist low HDL left not reported for her. Family 3 proband 'neurological examination was normal' recorded as such and excludes nothing more specific beyond the explicitly stated peripheral neuropathy. Tonsils: 'yellowish tonsils' absence (Family 1 and 2 probands) does not exclude the composite 'orange-colored or enlarged tonsils' (enlargement not addressed); the Family 3 proband's 'abnormal yellowish coloration of her tonsils' was recorded as observed for that checklist item (yellowish vs orange is a judgement). Family 2 proband's neuropathy is stated as 'consistent with neuropathy of mixed origin' (hedged; recorded observed). Ages of probands at presentation/referral (22, 26, 4 years) recorded as age at last evaluation, not onset. Contradictions/oddities in the paper: Methods name constructs 'ABCA1-Ala937Val' while Results/Discussion call the variant p.Arg937Val (c.2810C>T); recorded as printed (p.Arg937Val). The abstract prints the intronic variant as 'c.417611T>G' while Results print 'c.4176-11T>G'; the Results form was used. The Family 2 father (201) is said to have died of cancer, yet his HDL-C and genotype are reported (presumably from earlier samples; not stated). Triglycerides of Family 1 (1.22 mmol/L) and Family 2 (1.28 mmol/L) probands are not interpreted by the authors, so hypertriglyceridemia is not reported for them.
